must_fix.title: Keyboard focus ring on the selected genre filter option has ~1.07:1 contrast against its pill background
must_fix.evidence: css/styles.css:96-99 draws a 3px var(--focus) outline at 2px offset, which lands on the var(--accent) background set by .genre-option:has(input:checked) (css/styles.css:305-308). Arrow keys move focus and select together, so the focused radio is always the selected one. Playwright probe after focusing #genre-all and pressing ArrowRight: light {id:'genre-mystery', checked:true, outline:'rgb(31, 78, 121) 3px', pillBg:'rgb(122, 46, 46)'}; dark {outline:'rgb(156, 201, 255) 3px', pillBg:'rgb(232, 180, 143)'}. Contrast: light focus/accent 1.07, dark 1.08, below the 3:1 WCAG 1.4.11 asks for. The issue requires the site to be accessible; tests/site.test.js:237 only checks outlineStyle != 'none'.

nits: #message-count is not linked to the textarea through aria-describedby, and checkField overwrites aria-describedby rather than adding to it.
Gift Wrap event: index.html says 'Drop in any time' while events.html says 'before 4:00 pm'.
November Winter Reading Circle copy asks people to bring 'a cold drink'.
js/main.js open-now status uses the visitor's local time zone, not the shop's, and never refreshes.
Inside the selected pill, accent-color makes the radio the same colour as the pill background, so the radio dot is barely visible.

report:
I'd ask for one fix before merging: the keyboard focus ring on the selected genre filter has almost no contrast with the pill behind it.

All 28 tests pass (`node --test`). The pages make no off-origin requests, and none of the four scrolls sideways at 360px or at 320px. The 14 books, the filter, Back/Forward and the event dates (each weekday matches its date) all work. The text colours have good contrast in both light and dark mode; the lowest pair is 4.63:1. The repo has no lint or format config, so there were no other checks to run.

**Must fix: focus ring on the selected genre is close to invisible.** I measured with Playwright and a contrast script (`/tmp/claude-0/-tmp-ff-eval-nix2u54h-workspace/209f7ff9-291e-4f95-adc2-b3848a916964/scratchpad/p.js` and `c.py` in the same folder). Tabbing into the filter and pressing ArrowRight gives:

```
light { id: 'genre-mystery', checked: true, outline: 'rgb(31, 78, 121) 3px', pillBg: 'rgb(122, 46, 46)', fv: true }
dark  { id: 'genre-mystery', checked: true, outline: 'rgb(156, 201, 255) 3px', pillBg: 'rgb(232, 180, 143)', fv: true }
light focus accent 1.07
dark  focus accent 1.08
```

- **Cause:** `css/styles.css:96-99` uses a 3px `--focus` outline with a 2px offset. That puts the ring on the `--accent` background that `.genre-option:has(input:checked)` paints on the pill (`css/styles.css:305-308`).
- **Why it matters:** with radio buttons, arrow keys move focus and select at the same time, so the focused radio is always the selected one, sitting on the accent pill. The ring there has about 1.07:1 contrast against the pill. WCAG 1.4.11 asks for 3:1 against adjacent colours. In the light-theme screenshot it is a navy square on maroon and hard to see.
- **Why the tests miss it:** the existing focus test (`tests/site.test.js:237`) only checks that `outlineStyle` isn't `none`, not whether the ring can be seen.

**Nits (not blocking):**
- **Message counter not linked:** `#message-count` isn't tied to the textarea, so screen readers never announce it. `checkField` also replaces `aria-describedby` outright, so a later link to the counter would be lost.
- **Gift Wrap event times disagree:** the home page says "Drop in any time", but `events.html` says "Drop in any time before 4:00 pm".
- **Event copy:** the Winter Reading Circle in November asks people to bring "a cold drink".
- **Open-now line uses the visitor's clock:** the line in `js/main.js` uses the visitor's local time zone rather than the shop's, and it doesn't refresh while the page stays open.
- **Radio dot hard to see:** inside the selected pill, `accent-color: var(--accent)` paints the radio in the same colour as the pill, so the radio dot itself barely stands out.

`git status` is unchanged. My scratch files are only in the scratchpad.
